devops.name: S3 Deployment Strategy
devops.code:
# Deploy script for micro-frontends
#!/bin/bash

BUCKET_NAME="modulefederation-bucket"
DISTRIBUTION_ID="E1234567890ABC"

# Build all micro-frontends
cd packages/container && yarn build
cd ../marketing && yarn build
cd ../auth && yarn build
cd ../dashboard && yarn build

# Deploy to S3 with versioning
aws s3 sync packages/container/dist s3://$BUCKET_NAME/container/latest/ --delete
aws s3 sync packages/marketing/dist s3://$BUCKET_NAME/marketing/latest/ --delete
aws s3 sync packages/auth/dist s3://$BUCKET_NAME/auth/latest/ --delete
aws s3 sync packages/dashboard/dist s3://$BUCKET_NAME/dashboard/latest/ --delete

# Invalidate CloudFront cache
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $DISTRIBUTION_ID --paths "/*"

businessRequirements.businessContext: Demonstrate modern micro-frontend architecture where independent teams can develop, test, and deploy separate applications that integrate seamlessly at runtime
businessRequirements.problemStatement: Traditional monolithic frontends create team bottlenecks, framework lock-in, and deployment dependencies that slow down development velocity
businessValue: Reduced build times and faster CI/CD pipelines
acceptanceCriteria: ✓ Container app loads remote modules at runtime
